# StashBook

StashBook is a retro-styled aggregator that tracks free game giveaways, developer books, and iconic digital loot from Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Prime Gaming, itch.io, and other storefronts.

## Main Sections

- [Free Game Deals](https://stashbook.online/) — Live and expired free game offers grouped by platform.
- [Tech Archives](https://stashbook.online/books) — Curated free programming and developer books.
- [Iconic Drops](https://stashbook.online/iconic) — Legendary and high-value free game promotions.
- [About](https://stashbook.online/about) — How StashBook works and project disclaimer.
- [Contact](https://stashbook.online/contact) — Send feedback or report broken links.
